name: Brutal mogging

card.summary: Community slang for a decisive 'mog', where one person outclasses another across several traits at once, which people use to decide which parts of their own look to improve.

quick.overview:
To 'mog' someone is to outshine them in looks, and a 'brutal mog' is the intense version, where the gap shows in several categories together, such as face, build, height and style. Looksmaxxers use the idea as a prompt: seeing which areas set someone apart shows which areas to work on, whether gym, skin or grooming.

It is forum vocabulary, not a researched concept. Threads titled 'brutal mog' range from photo comparisons to real-world anecdotes, and the term appears in tier lists ranking how severe a mog is.
quick.how: In practice it is a way of talking: posters share a comparison or a story and label it. One post describes a man on a bridge noticed by a passing runner and says it made the author consider starting gym training, an example of the term turning into motivation.
quick.risks: The term is a ranking vocabulary, and the forums it appears in contain heated and often abusive exchanges, so the label can go with insults. It is subjective and has no measurement behind it.

lead: Brutal mogging is looksmaxxing slang for an especially thorough 'mog', the act of one person visually outclassing another. Where plain mogging can be about a single feature, a brutal mog is described as a win across several categories at once, such as face, physique, height or style.

Looksmax.org has many threads using the phrase, from titles such as 'brutal mog' and 'extremely brutal mogging' to a mogging tier list ordered from the least to the most brutal.[1][2][3] Posters sometimes use an episode as motivation: one author describes watching a jogger turn to look at a muscular man and says it made him consider gym training.[4]
No research addresses brutal mogging; it is a community judgement rather than a measured quantity.

chain: See where another person clearly stands out
Identify which categories drive the gap
Pick areas such as gym, skin or grooming to improve
angle.text: Posters use brutal mogs as reference points for what to improve. One described an encounter that made him want to start training.

infobox: A mog that wins on several traits at once

paras: Mogging means outshining someone by comparison. 'Brutal' marks the strong form. Forum titles use it for comparisons of photos, encounters in public, and videos of well-known looksmaxxing figures.[2][5]
A tier list thread ranks types of mog from least to most brutal, showing that users treat severity as a scale.[3] Another thread argues that one particular type is the most brutal of all.[6]

The vocabulary frames appearance as comparative and multi-factor. A poster describing a woman who looked back at a jogging man for several seconds said it made him seriously consider starting 'gymmaxing'.[4]

lore.intro: Brutal mogging is used on looksmax.org as a label for comparisons and anecdotes.[2][3]

claims.claim: Being outclassed in several categories at once is the most severe kind of mog
claims.believers: Forum users rank mogs by severity in tier lists and threads.[3][6]
claims.experts: No published research has examined mogging or measured its severity.
